Contributing

Contributions are welcome: bug reports, game compatibility notes, fixes, documentation and translations. This repository, Vodka Stack, is a monorepo, so use the guide that covers the area you are modifying.

Choose the correct area

Area Path Guide
macOS application (SwiftUI, Wine, Steam) apps/vodka/ apps/vodka/CONTRIBUTING.md
GTA V Enhanced mod tooling apps/openv/ apps/openv/PLAN.md
Patched Wine source engine/winecx/ engine/README.md
DXMT and the DirectX layer engine/dxmt-work/dxmt/ engine/README.md

If you are an AI agent, read AGENTS.md first.

Before you begin

  • Bugs and game issues: search the existing issues, then open one with the bug report template. In the application, Help › Run Diagnostics… produces a report containing settings and recent logs. Remove anything private before attaching it.
  • Features: open a feature request before implementing a large change.
  • Security: do not open a public issue. Follow SECURITY.md.

Development setup

An Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later with Xcode 16 or later is required.

# Build, ad-hoc sign and install /Applications/Vodka.app
apps/vodka/scripts/install-local.sh

# Unit tests
swift test --package-path apps/vodka/VodkaKit

Install the style-checking tools:

brew install swiftlint swiftformat

CI pins SwiftFormat 0.58.7. Homebrew installs the current release, which is usually newer, so verify swiftformat --version and install the 0.58.7 release if --lint reports differences that CI does not.

OpenV's map rebuild requires GTA V Enhanced to be installed in a Vodka bottle; see apps/openv/Rebuild OpenV Map.command. The engine lanes build with engine/local-build.rb.

Checks before a pull request

Run the checks for the area you changed:

Changed Run
VodkaKit logic swift test --package-path apps/vodka/VodkaKit
Application or UI xcodebuild -project apps/vodka/Vodka.xcodeproj -scheme Vodka -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
User-facing strings cd apps/vodka && ./scripts/british-english.py --check
Swift style cd apps/vodka && swiftformat --lint . && swiftlint --strict
Secrets cd apps/vodka && ./scripts/scan-secrets.sh
OpenV run the affected script against a real dump; the map rebuild is manual
Engine cd engine && ruby local-build.rb

The workflows were inherited from the application repository and reside in apps/vodka/.github, so GitHub does not run them from the monorepo root. Run the checks locally; a reviewer will confirm them.

Pull requests

  • Every change lands through a pull request. Direct pushes to main are not accepted. Do not wait to be asked for a pull request; branch, push and open one.
  • One change per pull request. Keep diffs focused and reviewable.
  • Commit messages are imperative and scoped: vodka: fix Steam launch resolver, openv: verify entity list bounds, engine: bump DXMT, docs: update the README.
  • Sign off every commit with git commit -s to certify the Developer Certificate of Origin.
  • Changelog: describe user-facing changes under [Unreleased] in apps/vodka/CHANGELOG.md.
  • Swift files require the GPL header used throughout apps/vodka, which SwiftLint enforces.
  • New application-target files must be added to Vodka.xcodeproj; VodkaKit discovers files automatically.
  • Strings belong in Vodka/Localizable.xcstrings in English only, edited as text.
  • Game fixes belong in GameDatabase/Resources/GameDB.json, with a source link.
  • No secrets, signing keys, certificates or provisioning profiles may be committed.
  • OpenV contributions must keep it single-player only, without anti-cheat bypass or game-asset redistribution, and must preserve its ABI.

Licensing of contributions

By submitting a contribution you agree that it is licensed under the license of the area you changed: GPL-3.0 for apps/vodka and the workspace, MIT for apps/openv, and LGPL-2.1-or-later for the engine sources. See NOTICE.md. There is no CLA.
